# Test image fixtures — attribution & licensing

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **These image files are third-party assets and are NOT covered by this project's MIT license.**
> Each file is redistributed here under its own license (listed below). The project's MIT
> LICENSE applies to the project's own source/content only — not to the files in this folder.
> All files are unmodified copies of the originals from Wikimedia Commons. They are used as
> `node_set_fill` image-fill test fixtures (§1) and are **not** part of the published npm
> package — only `dist/` ships; these live under `src/` (test fixtures), which is not in
> `package.json` `files`. They ship only in the git repo.

Each entry lists the local file, the original title/author, its license (with link), and both the
Commons file page (canonical source/attribution) and the direct image URL used by the `url`-path tests.
